chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a sunrise opening: a rapid harp arpeggio sweeping upward, the pad blooming like light breaking the horizon, a bright held chord that springs into the theme}
positive_styles: bright singing pulse-wave lead with lifting phrases
warm second lead answering the melody a bar later in call and response
quick shimmering harp arpeggios over a lush warm string pad bloom
